UI_QMSS_partial: Some targets were not saved; staged edits retained
UI_QMSS_RulesTip: Manual rules: edited here. <LINE> Presets: add coverage independently. <LINE> Selected count: distinct item names covered by manual rules and Presets. <LINE> Partial categories: current item names with item-rule routing priority.
UI_QMSS_ControlsTip: Checkbox: select or clear. <LINE> Shift-click checkbox: apply target state to a range of the same row type. <LINE> Ctrl-click: toggle one row and keep the range anchor. <LINE> Label click: expand or collapse. <LINE> Shift-click label: expand or collapse all. <LINE> Ctrl+A: select visible items. <LINE> Ctrl+Shift+A: clear visible items. <LINE> Right-click / Bulk actions: more selection controls. <LINE> Controller A: select. <LINE> Controller X/Y: expand. <LINE> Controller Bulk actions: range selection controls.
UI_QMSS_SharedTip: This item name is shared by multiple categories. Its explicit selection is shared too.
UI_QMSS_WholeContainerTip: Shared rules: apply live to inheriting sections. Custom sections keep their own rules.
UI_QMSS_TargetUnavailable: This target is unavailable or unsupported.
UI_QMSS_LoadedOnly: Loaded containers refreshed; unloaded areas are omitted
UI_QMSS_conflict: Target changed elsewhere; staged edits retained
UI_QMSS_authority: Server support unavailable; no save performed
UI_QMSS_failed: Operation failed; verify world state before retrying
UI_QMSS_ChooseTarget: Select a container from the server list to begin
UI_QMSS_schema: Stored configuration uses an unsupported or invalid schema
UI_QMSS_legacy-invalid: Legacy configuration is invalid; nothing was changed
UI_QMSS_taxonomy: Stored category rules use an unsupported taxonomy version
UI_B47_SortStopped: Sorting stopped: %1 moved, %2 skipped. Check carried items.
UI_B47_SortBusy: Finish or cancel the current action before sorting.
UI_QMSS_PresetDeleteConfirm: Delete this shared preset? Linked containers will stop using it.
UI_QMSS_PresetDenied: Only the preset owner or a server administrator may change this preset.
UI_QMSS_WishInactive: Dibs! List - Wanted Items — progress not active
UI_QMSS_PhysicalQuantity: Quantity: physical items; bottles count as containers, not uses.
UI_QMSS_DibsMultiTip: Selected items: %1. Inspect an individual item to see its Wanted order and Needed players.
UI_QMSS_ProjectQuantity: Number of recipe executions / builds to plan
UI_QMSS_unsupported: Shopping supports fixed whole items and non-degrading reusable tools. Partial uses, fluids, variable amounts and mixed consumed/reusable types are not supported. No partial request was added.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingTotals: Gross %1 / carried credit %2 / collect %3 / collected since edit %4
UI_QMSS_WishExists: This type already has a Dibs! Wanted. Edit its target in the Dibs! List - Wanted Items.
UI_QMSS_ManualRecipeUnsupported: Shopping does not yet support manually selected recipe inputs. Switch to automatic input selection.
UI_QMSS_evolvedUnsupported: Supports empty dry bases and full native portions from fresh, uncooked, unfrozen food. Partial portions, water/fluid operations, replacement ingredients and mixed portion/whole-item demand are unsupported. No partial project was added.
UI_QMSS_NoSources: No eligible matching supplies found in discovered containers
UI_QMSS_ResetPreferencesWarning: Reset all Shopping Preferences to Any and restore duplicate confirmation?
UI_QMSS_DuplicateConfirmation: Confirm Before Adding Duplicate Shopping Items
UI_QMSS_DuplicateWarning: This source has already been added to your Shopping List. Add it again?
UI_QMSS_DuplicateBulk: %1 new items; %2 already represented. Add the represented items again?
UI_QMSS_NoApplicablePreferences: This item has no applicable Shopping Preferences.
UI_QMSS_NeededExists: This item already has a Dibs! Needed target.
UI_QMSS_PersonalScope: My personal supply lists — shared carried credit
UI_QMSS_ShoppingDescription: Collect supplies for your personal requests.
UI_QMSS_NoSelection: Select a row to inspect its item and source.
UI_QMSS_HelpText:
Sorting: configure the selected container.
Changes remain staged until Save; Cancel discards them.
Shopping and Dibs! lists are personal, not container settings.
Choose a list to add items or edit targets.
Collection uses the existing nearby-container discovery.
UI_QMSS_SharedCreditExplanation: Credit is allocated once across requirements. Overlapping linked Dibs! targets use the greater target; other demand is independent.
UI_QMSS_BulkAllExplanation: Add all unfulfilled goals in this list, including rows hidden by this search. Existing sources require confirmation; linked targets remain synchronized.
UI_QMSS_timeout: Server did not reply. Use Refresh to retry discovery.
UI_QMSS_TaxonomyPeerMismatch: Client and server category taxonomies differ. Use the same mod build on both.
UI_QMSS_IncompatibleMod: B47ANCE'd Quartermaster cannot be used with %1. Disable one of the two mods before continuing.
UI_QMSS_ContainersFailed: Couldn’t load storage containers. Try Refresh.
UI_B47_SortNothing: Nothing was moved. Check destinations and available space.
UI_QMSS_CompatibilityUnknown: Unable to verify active mods. Check the server mod list and restart before using Quartermaster.
UI_QMSS_ProtocolMismatch: Quartermaster protocol mismatch. Update the server and all clients to a compatible build.
UI_QMSS_rateLimited: Server request limit reached. Wait briefly, then try again.
UI_B47_SortFailed: Sorting failed: %1. %2 moved, %3 skipped. Check carried items.
UI_QMSS_SortingSummaryTip: Configure category and item rules. Open Help for selection controls.
UI_QMSS_ScopeTip: View: filter displayed containers. <LINE> Sorting: uses the server discovery scope.
UI_QMSS_ParentRulesTip: Shared rules: apply live to inheriting sections. Custom sections keep their own rules.
UI_QMSS_InheritedTip: Rules: inherited from Whole Container. Choose Customize Section to edit independently.
UI_QMSS_CustomTip: Rules: complete independent section settings. Reset restores live inheritance.
UI_QMSS_PartialGroupTip: Some sections are hidden or unavailable. Shared changes require all sections visible and accessible.
UI_QMSS_CustomizeTip: Stage independent section settings. Save commits; Cancel discards.
UI_QMSS_ResetWholeTip: Confirm reset, then Save to restore live inheritance.
UI_QMSS_RemoveWholeTip: Confirm removal, then Save. Inheriting sections keep their effective rules as independent settings.
UI_QMSS_DibsMore: %1 more players. Choose Inspect Dibs! for the complete list.
UI_QMSS_BuildingDisabledTip: Whole Building discovery is disabled or no building is available. The server controls discovery.
UI_QMSS_CopyWholeTip: Stage complete independent copies on all visible sibling sections. Save commits; Cancel discards.
UI_QMSS_WindowLayoutTip: Adjust window size or container panel width; reset the window layout.
UI_QMSS_RoomPreviewOnly: Preview only - changes are not saved.
UI_QMSS_RoomWorldHelp: World: drag a rectangle or click two corners. Controller: D-pad, A to mark corners, Y for controls, B to cancel.
UI_QMSS_RoomCandidate: Detected candidate - edit or confirm to save.
UI_QMSS_RoomNativeWarning: Native room outline may not reflect remodeling.
UI_QMSS_RoomDeleteConfirm: Delete designation %1? Containers, items and sorting settings will remain.
UI_QMSS_RoomMergePreview: Merge preview - the selected room ID survives.
UI_QMSS_RoomMergeConfirm: Merge %1. Surviving room ID: %2. Other IDs become unavailable.
UI_QMSS_RoomSplitConfirm: The first region keeps %1; the second receives a new ID.
UI_QMSS_RoomIncompleteConfirm: Detection was incomplete. Save only these explicitly reviewed tiles? No enclosure is inferred.
UI_QMSS_RoomDisconnectedWarning: Disconnected regions require explicit permission below; membership does not guarantee a path.
UI_QMSS_RoomOverlayLimit: Other-room overlay limit reached; the selected boundary takes priority.
UI_QMSS_RoomAlreadySaved: The room was saved before cancellation arrived.
UI_QMSS_RoomUnloaded: Some required tiles are not loaded.
UI_QMSS_RoomDetectionLimit: Detection limit reached; review and edit the incomplete candidate.
UI_QMSS_RoomNoNative: This tile has no native room definition.
UI_QMSS_RoomGeometryInvalid: The boundary is empty or invalid.
UI_QMSS_RoomTooLarge: Room geometry exceeds the server or technical limits.
UI_QMSS_RoomNameInvalid: Use a nonempty plain-text room name (up to 96 UTF-8 bytes).
UI_QMSS_RoomDisabled: Custom rooms are disabled by the server.
UI_QMSS_RoomOutOfRange: The room is outside the allowed editing range.
UI_QMSS_RoomAssociationConflict: Rooms cannot combine different safehouse associations.
UI_QMSS_RoomDisconnected: Enable disconnected regions and confirm them before saving.
UI_QMSS_RoomSameFloor: Both rectangle corners must be on the same floor.
UI_QMSS_RoomSplitEmpty: A split must leave two nonempty regions.
UI_QMSS_RoomScopeConflict: Room scope expired. Save or discard staged sorting edits before reopening.
UI_QMSS_RoomLegend: Amber: selected / Green: added / Red: removed or invalid
UI_QMSS_RoomLegendOther: Cyan: saved / Purple: overlap or second split region
UI_QMSS_RoomOutcomeUnknown: Room save outcome unknown. Reopen and check the saved designation before retrying.
UI_QMSS_RoomFinishCompound: Save or undo the merge/split preview before another boundary operation.
UI_QMSS_RoomAlreadyIncluded: That room is already included in the merge preview.
UI_QMSS_RoomSaveSortingFirst: Save or discard staged sorting changes before sorting this room.
UI_QMSS_RoomSorting: Sorting the room using saved rules. Configuration resumes when sorting stops.
UI_QMSS_RoomEditConflict: The room library changed. Reload the saved room and review your boundary before saving again.
UI_QMSS_RoomAccessDenied: You do not have permission to access this storage.
UI_QMSS_RoomAccessChanged: Storage access changed. Sorting stopped safely.
UI_QMSS_RoomScopeChanged: Room scope changed. Reopen the menu before sorting again.
UI_QMSS_RoomBuildingUnavailable: Building sorting is unavailable under the current server scope settings.
UI_B47_Skip_destinationRejected: matching destinations could not accept items (%1)
UI_QMSS_DangerousLoadHelp: Use the native maximum inventory allowance instead of the normal comfortable limit. Native admission, movement penalties and health effects still apply. Default disabled.
UI_QMSS_LoadUtilizationHelp: Upper bound as a percentage of the current native inventory capacity. Default 100%; supported range 50-100%.
UI_QMSS_LoadPenalties: Heavy loads retain vanilla encumbrance and injury risks.
UI_QMSS_LoadScreenTooSmall: Load settings need more screen space. Increase the game resolution or reduce the UI font size.
UI_QMSS_LedgerScopeUnavailable: No supported building or safehouse is available here, or the scope exceeds the inspection limit.
UI_QMSS_LedgerScopeChanged: The ledger belongs to another building, or its scope changed. Resume inside its original scope.
UI_QMSS_LedgerChanged: Container contents changed while writing. Inspect this container again.
UI_QMSS_LedgerPower: A nearby supported desktop computer with power and inspection access is required.
UI_QMSS_LedgerStale: Stale snapshot: previously recorded storage is no longer available
UI_QMSS_LedgerLimited: Complete snapshot of accessible storage; access was limited
UI_QMSS_LedgerBlank: Blank supply sheet. Use Record building or safehouse from its inventory context menu.
UI_QMSS_LedgerSaved: Ledger CD created. Original paper retained.
UI_QMSS_LedgerUnreachable: Inspection stopped: a container could not be reached. Completed entries are retained.
UI_QMSS_LedgerScreenSmall: The Supply Ledger needs more screen space. Increase resolution or reduce the UI font size.
UI_QMSS_LedgerStatic: Static history; each container has its own recording time
UI_QMSS_LedgerSearch: Search item name or FullType (literal, case insensitive)
UI_QMSS_LedgerNoWritingTool: A pen or pencil is required to record supplies.
UI_QMSS_busy: Another Quartermaster operation is active. Finish or cancel it first.
UI_QMSS_LedgerSyncPending: The server created the ledger CD, but inventory synchronization failed. Reconnect to refresh it; do not repeat the conversion.
UI_QMSS_LedgerPageChanged: The ledger or access changed. Returning to its first page.
UI_QMSS_ComputerNoApplication: There is no runnable application on the inserted CD.
UI_QMSS_ComputerEjected: CD unloaded; it remains in storage.
UI_QMSS_ComputerNoCD: No ledger CD in accessible adjacent storage
UI_QMSS_ComputerBlankCD: This CD has no Supply Ledger application.
UI_QMSS_ComputerInsertHint: Place a ledger CD in an accessible desk/container beside this computer, then load it.
UI_QMSS_ComputerRunHint: Double-click QUARTERMASTER.EXE or choose Run application.
UI_QMSS_ComputerOverwrite: Write replaces the selected CD. Your paper is kept.
UI_QMSS_ComputerEjectFirst: Eject the mounted CD before writing another disc.
UI_QMSS_ComputerMediaLost: The storage CD, computer or access is no longer available. Application closed.
UI_QMSS_LedgerRequired: Fresh ledger required for this location. Carry a current completed ledger, or load a matching CD at an accessible powered computer. Inventory/selected-container Sort does not require a ledger.
UI_QMSS_LedgerDriveChanged: The computer or storage CD changed. Refresh the drive and load the CD again.
UI_QMSS_LedgerDriveOccupied: Eject the currently loaded storage CD before loading or writing another.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperSelectTip: Choose a shopping list carried in your inventory. Give the paper to another player to share its list.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperNone: No carried shopping list. Create a new paper list.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperMaterials: Create a list with one blank sheet of paper, a notebook and a pen or pencil. The notebook and writing tool are kept.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperImportTip: Copy your previous personal shopping plan onto one new paper. Requires writing supplies and one blank sheet; the original plan is preserved.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperMissing: Carry and select the shopping paper to use this list.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingWritingRequired: A notebook and a pen or pencil are required to create or edit shopping lists. Reading and collecting do not need writing supplies.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingBlankRequired: Carry one blank sheet of paper to create a shopping list.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperCreated: Shopping list created. Select it in Shopping, or hold it in either hand to show its checklist.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingAlreadyImported: Your old shopping plan has already been imported. The backup is preserved.
UI_QMSS_ShoppingPaperSyncPending: Shopping list created on the server, but the native inventory update could not be confirmed. Refresh/reconnect before retrying; no replacement paper will be created for this request.
UI_QMSS_LedgerDisabled: Supply ledgers, CDs and computers are disabled by the server.
UI_QMSS_LedgerLive: Live statistics for recorded storage; checked on the server
UI_QMSS_LedgerLiveUnavailable: Current storage unavailable. Its identity, loading or inspection permission changed. Record the location again or use Historical mode.
UI_QMSS_LedgerExpired: Outdated historical record; update it for Room/Building Sort
UI_QMSS_AllocationExactPrompt: Maximum storage allocation (0–100%). Changes remain a local preview until saved.
UI_QMSS_AllocationInvalid: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
UI_QMSS_AllocationCapacityUnavailable: Storage allocation could not be verified.
UI_QMSS_AllocationIdentityUnavailable: An item definition could not be verified.
UI_QMSS_AllocationHierarchyAmbiguous: An item has conflicting category paths.
UI_QMSS_AllocationReservationConflict: This item already has pending allocation work.
UI_QMSS_AllocationReservationLimit: Storage allocation is busy. Try again.
UI_QMSS_AllocationPreviewText:
Target: %1
Changed category rules: %2
Changed exact-item overrides: %3
UI_QMSS_AllocationPreviewPreserved: Existing selections, exclusions, priorities and compartment inheritance remain unchanged. Linked presets remain active. This replaces the local allocation profile only; it does not move items. Save to submit the preview.
UI_QMSS_AllocationThresholdsTip: Primary overflow / Secondary return thresholds. Staged locally until Save. Role and room type are configured in Rooms.
UI_QMSS_AllocationPresetUnavailable: The allocation preset is unavailable or its generation changed.
UI_QMSS_AllocationPresetUnmapped: This preset has no matching categories in the authoritative catalog. Existing rules were preserved.
UI_QMSS_AllocationCatalogUnavailable: Authoritative item metadata is unavailable. Try again after game scripts finish loading.
UI_QMSS_AllocationSnapshotBudget: The complete storage snapshot exceeded its bounded work budget. No quota admission was granted.
UI_QMSS_AllocationOccupancyUnavailable: Native storage weight could not be reconciled with captured items. No quota admission was granted.
UI_QMSS_AllocationScopeLimit: The allocation scope exceeds supported snapshot bounds. No partial scope is authorized.
UI_QMSS_AllocationActivationBlocked: Allocation enforcement awaits native and dedicated acceptance. Legacy sorting remains authoritative.
UI_QMSS_AllocationKeyboardTip: Alt+Left/Right: adjust selected allocation by 5%. Alt+Enter: exact value. Controller: use the allocation context menu.
UI_QMSS_AllocationRoomDefaultsMissing: Assign a room type in B47ANCE'd Rooms to use room-type defaults.
UI_QMSS_AllocationDiagnosticsDenied: Allocation diagnostics require a server administrator.
UI_QMSS_AllocationCeilingsTip:
Capacity: percentages use the same physical storage basis.
Limits: every explicit ancestor and room ceiling still applies to item overrides.
Parent edit: replaces descendant overrides throughout that branch.
Indicators: L = legacy, ~ = inherited, = = explicit; Mixed means differing child values.
Status: this build previews allocations; enforcement is not enabled.
UI_QMSS_AllocationNoOverLimit: No captured stock exceeds this local profile.
UI_QMSS_AllocationTruncated: Only the first 32 over-limit rules are shown.
UI_QMSS_LedgerTableSelect: Select an entry to view recording details.
UI_QMSS_LedgerComputerOffsite: Recorded inventory only. Live computer updates require the exact building recorded by this ledger; safehouse-wide ledgers have no single building.
